description: This file contains functions for generating a gross and net profit report in an accounting system, including data processing, revenue calculation, and profit computation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate gross and net profit report data based on filters.

methods.name: get_revenue
methods.description: Calculates revenue data, filtering and adjusting account entries.

methods.name: remove_parent_with_no_child
methods.description: Removes parent accounts with no child accounts from data.

methods.name: adjust_account
methods.description: Adjusts account data to reflect totals for each account over periods.

methods.name: set_total
methods.description: Recursively sums totals for accounts and their parent accounts.

methods.name: get_profit
methods.description: Calculates gross profit or similar profit metrics over periods.

methods.name: get_net_profit
methods.description: Calculates net profit over periods considering gross and non-gross revenues and expenses.
